items.title: Chandigarh court directs Meta to remove AI-generated video of Punjab MLA Sukhpal Khaira
items.summary: A Chandigarh court has directed Meta platforms to remove from Facebook and Instagram a morphed and artificial intelligence-generated video depicting Punjab MLA Sukhpal Singh Khaira in an off-shoulder women’s dress. Civil Judge (Junior Division) Kaushal Kumar Yadav passed the ad interim order on August 12 after finding that Khaira had made out a prima facie case for an injunction. “ The content uploaded is apparently defamatory, objectionable and AI generated, ” the Court said. The Court added that Khaira would suffer irreparable loss and injury if the content continued to remain accessible and circulate on public platforms. The court directed Meta, its agents and representatives to disable access to the identified video and posts uploaded on the Facebook page “Charda Punjab” and Instagram account “Chard_apunjab”. The content and identified URLs must be removed within 72 hours of Meta receiving the order, the Court directed. Khaira, who represents the Bholath constituency in the Punjab Legislative Assembly, filed the suit seeking permanent and mandatory injunctions, protection of his reputation, dignity and personality rights.
